Project.title: Project
Project.description: Civil engineering concrete estimation project with mix parameters, cost breakdown, and wastage analysis.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project document.

date.description: ISO date format of the estimate.

structure.description: Type of structural element (e.g. Slab, Footing, Beam).

grade.description: Nominal concrete grade (M10, M15, M20, M25).

volume.description: Wet concrete volume in cubic metres.

notes.description: Additional site specifications and engineering notes.

rates.description: Unit market rates for cement, sand, and aggregate.

costs.description: Detailed material costs and total expenditure.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the project was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when the project was last modified.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: Stores user-specific concrete mix estimates and quantity surveying projects.
